policy: Ratchet rule: entries may only be removed. Additions require an explicit compatibility review and a rationale tied to an upstream-internal implementation detail.

entries.rationale: Exercises the upstream citty-specific command wrapper and its private CliError class directly. Public error and exit behavior remains covered through cli.test.ts and cli-process.test.ts against the shipped bins.
Imports the upstream CLI's private diagnostic formatter instead of invoking a bin. The equivalent public diagnostics remain covered through cli.test.ts against the shipped TypeScript bin.
Imports the upstream CLI's private streaming JSON writer rather than exercising CLI behavior. Decode output remains covered through cli.test.ts and cli-process.test.ts against the shipped bins.
